name: Stormbringer: Bursting raises Drowning's stack value, Washed Away shortens Drown's cooldown (#842, #3688)

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Drowning (806406) deals 80% bonus damage per stack without Bursting
DISCRIMINATING: Bursting (#842) raises Drowning's stack value from 80% to 100%
BASELINE: Drown's (806407) category cooldown is unmodified at 60000 ms without Washed Away
DISCRIMINATING: Washed Away (#3688) reduces Drown's category cooldown from 60000 ms to 45000 ms

contract: #842: Bursting (806397) tooltip promises 'Increases the stack value of Drowning by $s1%.' Drowning (806406) is the debuff Drown's periodic damage spell (806408) triggers to stack; its own tooltip renders Effect[0] (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER, 79+1 = 80) as 'Damage taken from Drown increased by $s1% per stack.' Bursting's Effect[0] is a stock SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 flat modifier (19+1 = +20) whose class mask matches only Drowning's family flags, applied through the engine's own Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers with no module code: 80 + 20 = 100. #3688: Washed Away (807657) tooltip promises 'Reduces the cooldown of Drown by $/1000;s1 sec.' Drown (806407) carries its cooldown as a category cooldown (Category 135, CategoryRecoveryTime 60000, no SPELL_ATTR6_NO_CATEGORY_COOLDOWN_MODS). Washed Away's Effect[0] is a stock SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN flat modifier (-15001+1 = -15000 ms) whose class mask matches only Drown and its rank chain (572760-572764), applied through Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns's own category-cooldown ApplySpellMod call: 60000 - 15000 = 45000.
